content.title: Marvel Rivals Season 7 Maintenance Schedule and Countdown | Marvel Rivals News
content.text: Marvel Rivals is preparing for its Season 7 update on March 20th, 2026. The servers will go offline for maintenance to add the new content. This update brings White Fox as a new Strategist hero, Tablet of Life and Time Battle Pass, Dual Life of Peter Parker event, new team-up abilities, and much more. Here's when the servers will go down for Season 7, when they'll be back up, and what to expect during the maintenance window. The Season 7 maintenance will start on March 20, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC. The maintenance will take about 2 hours. During this time, you cannot access Marvel Rivals at all. The servers will be completely offline while the development team applies the update. Here's when maintenance starts across different time zones: CityMaintenance Start TimeSan FranciscoMarch 20, 1:00 AM PDTNew YorkMarch 20, 5:00 AM EDTLondonMarch 20, 9:00 AM GMTTokyo, SeoulMarch 20, 6:00 PM JSTSydney, MelbourneMarch 20, 8:00 PM AEDTMumbai, DelhiMarch 20, 2:30 PM ISTMarvel Rivals Season 7 Maintenance Schedule for Different Time Zones Marvel Rivals Season 7 Countdown Here's a countdown to Season 7 release date and time: 0Days0Hours0Minutes0Seconds When Will the Marvel Rivals Season 7 Maintenance End? The maintenance should end around 11:00 AM UTC (2 hours after it starts). However, this timing can change if the development team runs into technical problems during the update process. Sometimes maintenance takes longer than planned. The servers will be back online when maintenance is complete. You can check our Marvel Rivals server status guide to stay updated. The game will also show a message when trying to connect if maintenance is still ongoing. How Big Is the Season 7 Update? We'll update this section with exact file sizes once players start downloading on March 20th. Marvel Rivals Season 7 Patch Notes What's New in Marvel Rivals Season 7 Season 7 brings major content additions to Marvel Rivals New Hero: White Fox joins as a Strategist character New Map: Lower Manhattan (Convergence map, launching April 3rd) New Costumes: White Fox - Yoon Ji Woo The Leader (available in store) The Punisher - Marauder Marksman (available in store) Ultron - Odinforce Ultron (available in store) Tablet of Life and Time Battle Pass featuring skins across 12 pages of rewards New System: Album System New Events: Dual Life of Peter Parker (launching March 20th) Basketball Shooting Challenge (Times Square event) Flight Mode! World Tour Merch Vol.2 (launching March 27th) Happy April Pool Day! (launching April 1st) New Accessories: Accessories for White Fox, Iron Fist, Hawkeye, Mister Fantastic, Ultron, Adam Warlock, Peni Parker, Bruce Banner, Elsa Bloodstone, and Venom Upcoming Content: Cloak & Dagger - Daring Duo and Captain America - ESU Showdown skins (March 27th) Invisible Woman - ESU Showdown and Mister Fantastic - ESU College Life skins (April 3rd) Deadpool & Jeff The Land Shark - Black, White and Broom and Iron Fist - ESU Showdown skins (April 10th) Season 7.5 begins April 17th The maintenance window affects all platforms simultaneously, so PC, PlayStation, and Xbox players will all be offline during the same time period. That's everything you need to know about the Marvel Rivals Season 7 maintenance schedule.
